data.narrative:
CarbonCure Technologies is a Series F climate and energy company that has raised $169M to date. The valuation universe for this stage includes one public comparable (ticker LNZA) and eight private peers in the Climate & Energy sector, with top private comparables including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here, applying a 1.3x step-up multiplier typical of Series F advancement to the $169M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $220M. Peer-median triangulation was not applied due to insufficient narrow peer set; while eight same-sector peers exist, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier classification. A broader all-sector median would introduce unacceptable comparability noise and was therefore excluded.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $187M (low) to $253M (high), with a median point of $220M. This range reflects typical step-up progression at Series F but carries material uncertainty given the reliance on a single method and the absence of tightly comparable stage-peer data. Key risks to valuation include sector-specific capital availability and the specific technology's commercialization trajectory relative to the broader climate tech peer set.
